name: Glororum Caravan Park
stayType: Family-run caravan park with touring pitches
accommodation: Hardstanding touring pitches with electric hook-up, plus caravan holiday homes
dogs: Pet friendly (extra charge per dog per night)
beachAccess: About a mile from Bamburgh; within easy reach of the beach
confirmedFeatures: Shower and toilet block with accessible facilities, launderette, dishwashing area, small shop, play area, skate park, football pitch, on-site warden
overview: A family-run park about a mile outside Bamburgh, with hardstanding touring pitches, some looking towards the castle or the Cheviots. Facilities include a modern shower block, launderette, small shop and play area, and wardens live on site. Bamburgh's long beach is a few minutes' drive away.
surfTripFit: Hardstanding hook-up pitches a mile from Bamburgh suit campervan surfers wanting a quiet, practical base.
